description: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited offers civil construction services in India. It constructs residential, commercial, residential-cum-commercial, industrial, infrastructure, and hospitality projects. The company also constructs concrete building structures and composite steel structures. In addition, it provides operations and maintenance services; and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services, as well as finishing works. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited is a subsidiary of PKH Ventures Limited.
